maria_cs: Hi team — kicking off Aquila Therapeutics onboarding. Quick sync to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a 6-week timeline. Suggested kickoff meeting: Tue 10am PT. agenda: tech intake, data paths, enablement schedule, go-live checklist. Can everyone confirm owners?

karim_aquila: Thanks Maria — confirmed. I'll be the primary customer contact. Owners from Aquila: me (product lead), Priya (data engineering), and Dr. Chen (clinical lead). Tue 10am PT works. Our top success criteria: 1) inference latency < 400ms p95 on test dataset, 2) sanitized PHI handling validated, 3) internal team trained on Console.

ajeng_se: Noted. I'll own tech intake and model validation. Need Priya's network/IPs for allowlist and a snapshot of sample payload sizes. Also: which model variant are we starting with? customer said "redwood-small-v1" in intake form.

karim_aquila: Correct — starting with redwood-small-v1. Priya will post IPs after standup. Payloads average ~2.2k tokens. Expect a bursty traffic pattern during business hours.

samops: FYI from infra: if you'll use Dedicated or Private we need VPC peering details + CIDR. For hosted API we need a data processing agreement signed for PHI paths. Either way, plan for cert rotation window in week 3.

maria_cs: Great, squad. Preliminary timeline proposal: Week 0 (this week) — kickoff + tech intake; Week 1 — allowlist & test corpus ingestion; Week 2 — end-to-end test, perf tuning; Week 3 — security review & cert rotation; Week 4 — enablement + training; Week 5 — cutover rehearsals; Week 6 — go-live + success review. Any hard constraints from Aquila?

karim_aquila: Week 6 go-live target is firm — our internal release window is tight. Renewal risk: if we can't get PHI-safe validation by week 4, execs will push next decision to Q-trimester review. We'll prioritize PHI gating early.

lisa_enablement: I'll run two enablement sessions: "Console basics" (30m) in Week 4 and "Ops & incident runbook" (45m) in Week 5. Will prepare a one-page quickstart and a recording. Need product owners' emails for invites.

maria_cs: Action items captured. I'll post the shared onboarding board and a checklist. Quick check: owners list so I can add to board — @karim_aquila (Aquila PM), @ajeng_se (Redwood SE), @samops (Redwood Infra), @lisa_enablement (Enablement), @maria_cs (CS). Anyone else?

michael_pm: I'll attend the kickoff to cover rollout dependency with our Dedicated capacity team. Also want to flag billing review in Week 2 (commit vs pay-as-you-go).

ajeng_se: Tech prereq checklist I'll need from Aquila: 1) allowlist CIDRs, 2) sample payloads + schema, 3) SSO metadata if using SAML, 4) any PII/PHI examples redacted. I'll drop a small script to produce token distribution stats.

karim_aquila: Priya will send CIDRs and payloads today. SSO: we'll use Okta, will provide metadata by Friday.

maria_cs: Posting checklist now — please react with :white_check_mark: when you complete items.

maria_cs: ```
Onboarding checklist - Aquila Therapeutics
- Kickoff scheduled (owner: maria_cs)
- Allowlist / network (owner: priya_aquila / samops)
- Sample payloads ingested (owner: priya_aquila / ajeng_se)
- PHI handling policy signed (owner: karim_aquila / legal)
- End-to-end perf test (owner: ajeng_se)
- Security review & cert rotation (owner: samops)
- Enablement sessions (owner: lisa_enablement)
- Cutover rehearsal & rollback plan (owner: michael_pm)
- Go-live readiness review (owner: maria_cs)
```

maria_cs: Link to shared board: https://redwood-internal/boards/onboard-aquila (please add notes to cards)

onboarding-bot: Reminder: Kickoff meeting created for Tue 2025-04-15 10:00 PT — calendar invites sent to participants.

karim_aquila: Thanks — I'll accept and invite Priya + Dr. Chen. One more ask: can we get a perf baseline run on hosted API first before switching to Dedicated? would like to compare cost/latency.

ajeng_se: Yep, we can run a hosted baseline in Week 1 and follow up with quantization/recommendations for Dedicated in Week 2.

samops: Noted. If baseline looks good we can defer VPC setup but still start security review early.

maria_cs: Perfect. I'll follow up with a Week 1 checklist reminder and capture PHI gating as highest priority. Thanks all — see you Tue. :rocket:
